method.observation: Straight-rest arc test and bounded elbow fillet remove one demonstrated starting-shape risk. Actual collision donor and solve geometry are retained. Displacement guard stays90mm.

efficient_quality.observation: One leader and one near actor, cheap native proof before renders and propagation.
efficient_quality.comparison: No full sequence rerender or detailing a rejected torso.

authority.observation: Same task13/max17 under exact five-cycle approval. No spend or independent motion allowance change.

strongest_counterexample: A stable two-segment tube can still look like inflated anatomy, collide at the elbow, or transfer onto the wrong body surface. These results reject the garment even if the solver and tests pass. The complete actor cannot be delivered while face/crown/saddle fail.
